skills.name: aso-analysis
skills.description: ASO performance for an app or collection — tracked-keyword positions and (gate-iv-gated) trends, category-rank trend, keyword opportunities with competitor context, an interactive add-keyword loop (the only write path), and honest metadata suggestions. Emits a structured findings.json plus a self-contained HTML report. Trigger on "ASO report", "keyword rankings", "keyword opportunities", "how do we rank for <keyword>", "suggest keywords to add".
headings: Metadata optimization — honest read ladder (suggestions only; no metadata write exists)
Keyword effectiveness tiers (print the real definitions verbatim in the footer)
skills.description_zh: 分析应用或应用集合的 ASO 表现，包括跟踪关键词位置、gate-iv 门槛允许的趋势、类别排名、带竞品背景的关键词机会及有依据的元数据建议。通过交互循环添加关键词是唯一写入路径，输出 findings.json 和自包含 HTML 报告。

skills.name: competitors
skills.description: Find an app's real competitors in one region on one or both platforms, add the chosen ones to tracking, and build a competitive audit — share of search across live store results, newly discovered competitors, category position, and 30-day rating velocity with a star breakdown. Emits a structured findings.json plus a self-contained HTML report. Trigger on "who are our competitors", "competitor analysis", "competitive audit", "who outranks us in this country", "compare us against a named rival", "add competitors to tracking", "/competitors".
headings: 3. Discovery sweep (the engine of this skill)
5. Add to tracking (the only write path)
skills.description_zh: 在单一地区的一或两个平台发现真实应用竞品，把选定对象加入跟踪，审计实时搜索份额、新竞品、类别位置及按星级拆分的 30 天评价增长速度；输出 findings.json 与自包含 HTML 报告。

skills.name: feedback-analysis
skills.description: Analyze app or collection feedback over a window — KPIs with prev-window deltas, rating/volume/ sentiment trends, anomaly callouts, and ranked top bugs + feature requests — then emit a structured findings.json plus a self-contained HTML report. Read-only (never writes). Trigger on "feedback report", "how are our reviews", "what are users complaining about", "review trends for <app>".
skills.description_zh: 只读分析应用或集合在指定窗口的反馈，报告 KPI 与前窗口差异、评分数量情绪趋势、异常、排序后的主要缺陷及功能请求；输出 findings.json 和自包含 HTML，不写入。

skills.name: search
skills.description: Find an app on the App Store / Google Play and start tracking it in AppFollow, then hand structured app references to the feedback-analysis and aso-analysis skills. Read-only search + dedupe works on any plan; the add step degrades gracefully when the plan does not allow writes. Trigger on "find app X", "track our app", "add <app> to AppFollow".
skills.description_zh: 在 App Store 或 Google Play 查找应用并开始 AppFollow 跟踪，将结构化应用引用交给反馈和 ASO 分析。任意套餐可只读搜索去重；不允许写入的套餐会适当降级新增步骤。

skills.name: using-appfollow
skills.description: Always-loaded discipline for every AppFollow toolkit skill. Read this before calling any AppFollow MCP tool. Enforces the preview→approval→confirm write ritual, the shared MCP error-code vocabulary, and the public-tools-only posture. Other skills reference this file rather than restating the rules.
headings: MCP error-code vocabulary (surface verbatim; branch per skill)
skills.description_zh: 所有 AppFollow 工具调用前读取的共同规则，要求写入按预览→批准→确认进行，使用统一 MCP 错误码并仅访问公开工具；其他技能引用此规则。
